title: Pure Potan
summary: Level 1 Potan swarm and Synchro climbing build, paired with Cupid Volley, The Agent of Creation - Venus and Level 1 Fairy support. Red Potan summons additional Potans from the hand or Deck both by targeting a Potan on the field and whenever a monster is Synchro Summoned.

summary.title: Starters
points: Red Potan (Level 1 FIRE Fairy) targets a Potan you control to treat it as a Tuner, and if a monster is Synchro Summoned while you control Red Potan, it Special Summons a Potan from your hand or Deck.
One for One discards a monster to Special Summon Red Potan from the Deck without using your Normal Summon, and Where Arf Thou? searches any missing Level 1 Potan while you control a Level 1 monster.
The Agent of Creation - Venus pays 500 LP per summon to pull up to three Level 2 Mystical Shine Balls from the hand or Deck, giving instant Synchro material.

summary.title: Opening: Red Potan + The Agent of Creation - Venus
steps: Normal Summon The Agent of Creation - Venus and activate its effect to Special Summon Level 2 Mystical Shine Ball from the hand or Deck.
Special Summon Red Potan via One for One (or Court of Justice, or Normal Summon Red Potan alongside Venus with Court of Justice).
Activate Red Potan targeting itself to treat it as a Tuner.
Synchro Summon Level 3 Martial Metal Marcher using Level 1 Tuner Red Potan and Level 2 Mystical Shine Ball.
Martial Metal Marcher triggers on Synchro Summon to Special Summon Red Potan from your GY in Defense Position.
Activate Venus's effect paying 500 LP to Special Summon a second Level 2 Mystical Shine Ball from your Deck.

Synchro Summon Level 5 Synchro (or Level 4 Cupid Pitch) using Martial Metal Marcher and Mystical Shine Ball; Red Potan triggers on the Synchro Summon to Special Summon White Potan or Black Potan from your Deck.

summary.title: Potan Trio & Cupid Synergy
points: White Potan cannot be destroyed by battle while you control a face-up Tuner, and burns the opponent for 500 damage when a Tuner you control is destroyed by battle.
Black Potan cannot be destroyed by battle while you control a face-up Tuner, and gains 800 LP whenever a face-up Tuner leaves the field.

Cupid Volley mills up to 3 cards to raise its Level by up to 3, tuning with Red Potan into Level 4 Cupid Pitch, which adjusts its Level and searches The Agent of Creation - Venus (600 DEF) when used as Synchro Material.

summary.title: Extra Deck Payoff
points: Martial Metal Marcher (Level 3 Synchro Tuner) revives Red Potan from the GY on Synchro Summon so Red Potan's on-Synchro-Summon recruit triggers again on the next step.

Old Entity Hastorr and Armory Arm (Level 4 Synchros) equip from the GY or field to steal an opposing monster or grant +1000 ATK and battle burn, and can tune with a Level 4 Synchro Tuner into Level 8 Draco Berserker of the Tenyi, which banishes a monster that activates its effect.
Any two leftover Level 1 Potans overlay into Sylvan Princessprite to excavate a Spell/Trap or Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale for direct attacks.

summary.title: Spells
points: Court of Justice Special Summons any Fairy monster (Red Potan, White Potan, Cupid Volley or The Agent of Creation - Venus) from the hand once per turn while you control a Level 1 Fairy.

Where Arf Thou? searches Red Potan, White Potan, Black Potan or Cupid Volley while a Level 1 monster is on the field, and Black Potan's 800 LP gain offsets its End Phase burn if the searched monster stays in hand.
